blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The local government of Calapan has turned over free land allocations and financial assistance to residents affected by the recent demolition in Barangay Guinobatan. This is seen as a relief after the prolonged litigation over the contested real estate. As many as 294 families have been impacted by the dispute over a 158-hectare property that was awarded to 64 beneficiaries of Certificates of Land Ownership Award (CLOA) under the government’s land reform program.
